notablePrerequisites: Harabaz Druid does not have summoning sickness. You control at least three Allies.
easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Harabaz Druid.
description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Harabaz Druid by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
